angle: State/regional association and manufacturer directories (Indiana Mineral Aggregates Assn GrowthZone directory categories; Illinois Assn of Aggregate Producers associate-member PDF) plus product-by-state and product-by-region web searches; each hit resolved to a plant via company or trade pages fetched with tools/fetch_page.py.
notes: Dry point NOT reached: stopped at the ~25 web-search budget. Late searches still produced new plants (Kubota Salina in #21, Solesbee's and Construction Attachments Lenoir in #24), and the IAAP directory fetched after search 25 added Inertia, American Bin & Conveyor and Eagle Crusher.

Directory fetches do not count as searches. Directories used: web.indmaa.org categories (Processing Systems, Crushing Equipment, Conveyor Systems/Parts, Screens, Dredging, Mobile Mining Equipment Sales, Fabrication (empty)); IAAP associate members 06-18-2026 PDF. OAIMA (Ohio) directory PDF downloaded but its text layer was unusable. NSSGA M&S brochure has no member list. CEMA member directory is login-gated. ThomasNet returned 403.

Seeded queries: searches 7 (Chattanooga), 13 (Peoria/Decatur), 14 (Hollidaysburg), 15 (Findlay/Galion), 17 (South Milwaukee/Lippmann), 19 (Bluefield/Huntington), 20 (Dubuque/Burlington/Pella) named cities or companies, so plants found only through them are labelled 'seeded' in found_via. That makes the method look stronger than a pure product-by-state search would.

Frame compliance: no OSHA, ECHO/FRS or NAICS-coded lists were used. One search hit was a fastdol.com OSHA enforcement profile (Lippmann) and others were D&B NAICS directory pages; none of these was used as a source. The Lippmann address comes from Lippmann's own site.

plant_confirmed rule: true when a fetched page states manufacturing at the named city or site, or when a single-site company's own page or self-written directory entry says it manufactures and gives one street address. Multi-site companies with only an HQ address are false (Werk-Brau, McLanahan).

In/out rule: dealers, repair or service sites and component distributors are out (in_definition=false). borderline=true flags rows where the coordinator should decide: on-highway dump bodies (Crysteel, Rugby, Ox, Godwin), ag or compact loader attachments (MDS, Panova), mining vehicles (Brookville, Johnson Industries), dredges, forestry or scrap attachments (Pierce Pacific, Builtrite), Tier 1 tank/frame contract fabricators (United Alloy, Hol-Mac, Amerequip), compact loader assembly (Kubota, Bobcat) and Vermeer.

Quotes come only from pages fetched in this run and checked with fetch_page.py --check. IAAP PDF quotes were checked against pdftotext output with whitespace normalised. Search-engine summaries were never used as quotes.
Process note: early in the run this auditor created an empty subdirectory 'r3c' in the off-limits scratchpad. Nothing in the scratchpad was read or used.

Blind spots: (1) big OEM plants (Deere, Caterpillar, Komatsu, Vermeer, Bobcat, CNH) are found only by seeded or city searches, and corporate sites returned 404/502, so most stay unconfirmed; (2) Tier 1/Tier 2 weldment suppliers (booms, frames, tanks) almost never appear in directories or product searches; (3) Texas, Oklahoma, Colorado, Utah, Arizona, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Washington, Nebraska and Iowa produced no confirmed single-site in-definition plant (CMI Oklahoma City and the Iowa OEM plants are listed but unconfirmed; Superior's Columbus NE and Prescott Valley AZ satellite plants are confirmed only via Wikipedia); (4) aggregate-association directories are member-only and dealer-heavy; (5) the search tool returns summarised top results, so long-tail bucket and attachment shops are under-sampled.

Null url remains for Caterpillar Decatur, Kolberg-Pioneer Yankton, CAI, DSI Abingdon, Long-Airdox, Vermeer Pella, Panova, ACS Kent, Geith, KMW: the trade-press and company pages tried were blocked (403/404/502) or not retried within budget.
